description: Styles for the GuideSection component in a bike maintenance guide application, defining the layout and appearance of various elements within the section.

classes.name: guidesection-root
classes.description: Main container for the guide section with a gradient background, rounded corners, and shadow effects.

classes.name: guidesection-header
classes.description: Flex container for the header section with spacing for alignment.

classes.name: guidesection-emoji
classes.description: Style for the emoji icon in the guide section header, includes font size and shadow.

classes.name: guidesection-title
classes.description: Styling for the title of the guide section, including font weight and color.

classes.name: guidesection-desc home
classes.description: Styling for home description text including color and alignment.

classes.name: guidesection-list
classes.description: Flex container for listing steps or items, with spacing configurations.

classes.name: guidesection-step
classes.description: Style for individual steps in the guide, includes background, border, and shadow.

classes.name: guidesection-stepicon
classes.description: Style for step icons, including font size and text shadow.

classes.name: guidesection-steptitle
classes.description: Styling for the title of each step in the guide.

classes.name: guidesection-nosteps
classes.description: Style for displaying a message when there are no steps available.
